```json
{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "label_pos",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "sentiment_description",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Its two values (positive/negative) are a direct textual restatement of the focus variable label_pos; segmenting on it just reproduces the focus, offering no external relationship."
    },
    {
      "name": "review_character_count",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Length is an external associational variable comparable against sentiment, but the distribution is degenerate: 184 of ~250 values are capped at 700, so it is near-constant and cannot support meaningful segmentation as observed."
    },
    {
      "name": "detected_themes",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable, well-separated thematic categories (plot, acting, directing, etc.) that can be grouped and compared against positive vs negative sentiment; directly serves the query about theme differences."
    },
    {
      "name": "positive_sentiment_words",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A small-integer count with interpretable, comparable buckets (0-4) that can be segmented against sentiment; associational rather than a restatement, though somewhat close to the sentiment construct."
    },
    {
      "name": "negative_sentiment_words",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable low-cardinality count that can be grouped and compared against the focus; provides an informative lexical signal correlated with sentiment."
    },
    {
      "name": "sentiment_word_ratio",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A derived ratio of the two word counts; it is an opaque score whose values are fragmented across many fine-grained fractions and largely restates the pos/neg word columns, weakening interpretable segmentation."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 5,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.55,
  "rationale": "The set contains one strong, directly-on-topic EDA variable (detected_themes) with clean interpretable categories, plus usable lexical counts (positive/negative sentiment words) that can be segmented against sentiment. However, several columns dilute the set: sentiment_description merely restates label_pos, review_character_count is near-constant (capped at 700) and thus non-informative as observed, and sentiment_word_ratio is a fragmented derived score that largely duplicates the word-count columns. As a whole it supports discovering some interpretable relationships with the focus but is weakened by restatement and degenerate/opaque columns."
}
```
